paraphrase: In the existing universal selfC model, H, C(¬H) and ◇¬H hold at false but C(□¬H) does not: possible failure is not actual failure. In the one-step dead-end model H, □H and C(□¬H) hold at false but C(¬H) does not. Its lack of reflexivity and successor-seriality shows that no unconditional conflict follows on arbitrary frames.
